purpose: Measure chart-geometry rarity without personality data and without owner-fitted rule selection.

feature_definition.planet_pair_feature: absolute orb in degrees to nearest of 0,60,90,120,180 for every unordered planet pair
feature_definition.angle_feature: minimum absolute angular distance in degrees from each planet to ASC,MC,DSC,IC

reference.sampling: uniform distinct UTC minute-grid moments without replacement
reference.location_policy: condition angular reference on the participant birth latitude/longitude; planetary features are location-independent

primary_score.name: rank_gaussian_shrunk_mahalanobis
primary_score.marginal_transform: baseline empirical CDF to standard-normal quantile, clipped to [0.5/B,1-0.5/B]
primary_score.covariance: sample covariance of transformed baseline features
primary_score.rarity_percentile: (1 + number of calibration D2 values <= query D2)/(calibration_n + 1)
primary_score.tail_probability: (1 + number of calibration D2 values >= query D2)/(calibration_n + 1)

secondary_scores: mean marginal two-sided surprisal across all 55 features, calibrated on the same calibration sample
planetary-only primary score using the 45 pair features
angle-only primary score using the 10 angle features
anti_tuning: No personality, biography, astrology-belief, or owner six-rule score enters the metric.
All 45 planet pairs and all 10 planet-to-angle distances are included; no pair is selected for a person.
The score definition is frozen before computing the owner's v1 score.
